result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions. They now match the files they were meant for, and the old matches still hold. The new test class and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (6 + 6 tests, 0 failures) under `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer`. I did not commit.

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/`:

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`**
  - The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`.
  - The .NET doc-XML rule uses `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`.
  - The JavaScript `// Generated by` rule uses `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**: the Gradle JavaScript rule uses `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/DefaultConventionsTest.java`. It covers:
- `.htm` pages with the Doxygen and meta-generator rules, plus the existing `.html` and `.xhtml` cases.
- A hand-written `.htm` page and a hand-written `settings.xml` / `app.js` staying out of the generated scope.
- `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` matching their rules.
- `build-gradle.js` and `build.gradle` in the build-and-deployment scope.
